_doc.moves_on: Single moves switched on while their element is off: {KEY: [ROLE, ...]} (the key's chain counts: 'a/b' covers 'a/b.grown'). Only those roles play, from the move's own element's table; the master switch still rules. The owner's picks from a side-by-side.
_doc.what: The switches of the Spellbreak effects on Tidebreak's moves (SbFx, scripts/fx/cascade/sb_fx.gd). enabled false, or an element false: that element's moves look exactly as before (every seam falls back to today's visual). Effects: Spellbreak by Proletariat, rebuilt Cascade systems in res://assets/fx/spellbreak (SOURCE.md names each source package and the licence note).
_doc.max_playing: Effects playing at once (all scenes' SpellFx). Past it a new one does not play and today's look draws instead (the runtime is GDScript on the CPU: about 0.5 ms a frame per effect).
_doc.prewarm_per_frame: Effects built per prewarm step behind the ring's loading screen (BendLooks.warm_up calls SbFx.prewarm; a step is two frames). With the shader cache warm the whole prewarm takes about 2 s; the first launch on a machine compiles every Cascade shader (about 100 s for the ring's warm-up on an M4, once), so fewer per step keeps each frame shorter.
_doc.hide_materials: Emitters drawn with these source materials are left out of every effect (visual only): materials on the runtime's generic uber fallback that draw broken in the ring's daylight. MI_SimpleFresnelBall(3): a solid white disc instead of a fresnel rim (Fireball_Base_Impact01 'Range Sphere', SmkObscureM 'Ring', ShrineB_Pyro 'Shield Ring'); the glow cores and shock spheres (MI_SimpleGlow_FireballCore(DepthFade), M_SimpleGlow, MI_SphereShock, M_SphereErosion_SoftEdge(_harder)): flat grey discs and white or yellow domes up to 4 m across (Fireball_Base_Impact01, SmkObscureM/S, DropImpact, VaporCloud, Ice_Lance_Squib, EarthImpactAOE_FX_Meteor, WindExplode); SmokePuffB_FxM: a textured square (Fire_Firefly_End01 'Flame Round Burst'); MI_f_lightningBranchingBolt3: a black square (GauntletLightningMuzzle 'Lightning side'); MI_f_Particle_softGlow: a bright white-hot blob over hits and casts in daylight (the 'Big Glow', 'Hotball_glow', 'Light' sprites, meant for HDR bloom); GroundSmokeSplashClose_Drop_MI: a giant opaque orange-white sheet over the deck (DropImpact 'smokeybase', 'Dust'); MI_SmokeFixedLightingA: beige squares where a struck puff should be (SmkObscureS 'smoke translucent stretch'). An effect left with nothing to show does not play (today's look stays). Found by rendering each effect with one emitter left out at a time.
_doc.element files: data/bending/sb_fx/<earth|water|fire|air>.json: {format, version, element, source, moves: {KEY: {_slot, ROLE: ENTRY, ...}}, unwired: [{map_row, map, effect, why}]}. A tuner edits only his element's file.
_doc.KEY: The move as the game tags it: the hit info's tag 'move/mode' with its flags ('fire_blast/punch', 'fire_blast/punch.grown', 'rock_jab/pop_stone', 'fire_kick/slam_wave'), or a passive's or shared row's own ('rooted', 'flowing', 'passive/carried_wind', 'patch/patch', 'mend', 'clash/stone', 'stone_form/drop'). Lookup strips one suffix at a time ('a/b.grown' -> 'a/b' -> 'a'), so a '.grown' key needs only the roles that differ. Shared moves (patch, mend) are looked up in the caster's element's file first.
_doc.ROLE: The seam that plays it (fixed names; the code calls them): cast, flight, wave, trail, curve, impact, body_extra, hit_body, swing, zone, zone_start, zone_end, deflect, put_out, blown, entry, doused, melted, cushion, held, return_flight, perfect, late, whiff, rise, stand, hit, crumble, shatter (falls back to crumble), melt (falls back to crumble), hang, land, roll, drop, clash, dash, dash_trail, dash_flames, dash_end, grow, grow_click, charge, idle, take_hold, slam, slam_deck, air_hit, pop, cone, heal, heal_pop, mend, throw, low, flash, strike, lightning_back, kick_up, launch, air_trail, ride, ride_spray, charged, charge_pop. A role absent from a move keeps today's look; an entry with effect '' stops the lookup (today's look).

ENTRY.effect: the source package path of an imported effect (res://assets/fx/spellbreak/index.json; import more with tools/fx/import_spellbreak_fx.py). Required.
ENTRY.map / map_row / map_pick / note: provenance only: bending_fx_map.json's row index, its words, the pick used (0 when absent) and why.
ENTRY.at: hand (the caster's hands: the player's hand point, a bot's before its chest) | chest | feet | caster (the body's origin) | node (the bolt, zone, stone or wall) | point (the hit or given point) | ground (the deck under the point)
ENTRY.follow: true: moves with its anchor (a held effect at the hand follows the hand) | false: placed once in the world
ENTRY.orient: the frame its forward (Spellbreak's +X) points along: dir (the aim or flight, 3D) | flat (that, level) | node (the node's own turn) | normal (a hit's normal) | normal_up (its up along the normal) | up | down | world
ENTRY.follow_basis: with follow: node (turns with the node) | fixed (keeps its first turn) | motion (faces where the node moves: a tumbling stone's trail)
ENTRY.offset: [x right, y up, z back] metres in the orient frame
ENTRY.rot: [x, y, z] degrees, an extra turn in the effect's own frame
ENTRY.scale: uniform size (positions, speeds, sprite and mesh sizes, ribbon widths, light ranges)
ENTRY.keep_old: false: replaces today's visual at that seam | true: plays over it (kept where the old shape carries the gameplay read: a zone's extent, a wall's body)
ENTRY.start / stop: the seam's own words for when it starts and ends (read-only documentation of the hook)
ENTRY.life: seconds, then stopped (looping effects used as one-shots, held effects with a set length)
ENTRY.one_shot: default true: released once every emitter is done
ENTRY.tint: [r, g, b, a] multiplies the source colours (default none)
ENTRY.fit / fit_m / fit_clamp: scale by the thing it is fitted to: width | height | radius | length, over fit_m metres, clamped to [min, max]
ENTRY.spread / spread_m: copies side by side across the frame's x over spread_m (default the zone's width)
ENTRY.repeat_s: while its node stands, played again every repeat_s (a short effect over a long zone)
ENTRY.travel / travel_s: placed at the point and moved to ctx.to over travel_s (a strike drawn along its line)
ENTRY.volley_max / volley_rest: per volley (Pebbles, Embers): only the first volley_max play; the rest draw nothing ('none', default) or today's look ('old')
ENTRY.body_scale: times this when the point is on a body (struck puffs kept within the body's read)
